description: This Java class defines a service layer for managing notes, providing CRUD operations interfacing with a repository. It handles listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes, translating Note entities to DTOs for external use.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: A Spring service class responsible for handling CRUD operations for notes, encapsulating business logic and data access.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves all notes, returns a list of note DTO responses.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note from the provided request DTO and returns its DTO response.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with data from the request DTO, returns its DTO response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, throws exception if the note does not exist.
